answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the terrace log shows the live set and the ocean audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 690 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 228 aliases alive hence means 228 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the plume quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
